items.title: AI alone is cool.
items.description: AI alone is cool. But mastery + creativity + AI hits on a whole different level. Don't let anyone discourage you from pursuing excellence and craft. Keep studying the blade.
items.description_zh: 人工智能本身就很酷。但掌握+创造力+人工智能达到了一个完全不同的水平。不要让任何人阻止您追求卓越和工艺。继续研究刀片。
